description: Verbruiksgegevens per NACE Sector is a dataset listed in Fluvius open data portal, an open data portal of a distribution network operator, published or maintained by Fluvius (Flanders). De dataset bevat verbruiksgegevens geaggregeerd per energie (elektriciteit/gas), richting (injectie/afname), hoofdgemeente, NACE sectoren NACE subsector.. De verbruiken werden geaggregeerd naar een kalenderjaar (01/jan-31/dec). De hoofdgemeente bepalen we aan de hand van de postcode waar het punt zich bevindt (leveringsadres). Coverage: Belgium (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Netgebruikers en hun verbruik. Its keywords are Afname, Injectie, Verbruik, NACE, Gemeente, Toegangspunt. The portal shows 2026-08-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open data license - FLUVIUS (https://opendata.fluvius.be/p/licentieopendatafluvius). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-fluvius-open-data-portal.
